label: PC
description: Windows games you own (GOG, itch.io, Epic, discs), run by Lutris with GE-Proton and gamemode

perGame.why: Lutris already keeps one config per game (games/<slug>-<id>.yml) and edits it in its own window; a second copy here would only drift from it.

profileSaves.why: Each Windows game writes its saves wherever it likes inside its own Wine prefix (Documents, AppData, the game folder), so there is no one folder to give each profile.
